patent.title: Stacked thermal module with an integrated fluid channel (fictional example)

independent.text_verbatim: A stacked thermal module comprising: a substrate having a first surface; and a heat spreader thermally coupled to the first surface, the heat spreader defining a fluid channel that includes an inlet port and a folded flow path.

elements.text_verbatim: a substrate having a first surface;
a heat spreader thermally coupled to the first surface,
the heat spreader defining a fluid channel that includes an inlet port and a folded flow path.

independent.text_verbatim: A method of assembling a stacked thermal module, the method comprising: bonding a heat spreader to a first surface of a substrate; and sealing a folded flow path formed in the heat spreader.

elements.text_verbatim: bonding a heat spreader to a first surface of a substrate;
sealing a folded flow path formed in the heat spreader.

dependents.text_verbatim: The stacked thermal module of claim 1, wherein the fluid channel has a hydraulic diameter of 0.08 mm.

additions.text_verbatim: wherein the fluid channel has a hydraulic diameter of 0.08 mm

dependents.text_verbatim: The stacked thermal module of claims 1 and 2, wherein the substrate comprises a ceramic layer having a thickness of 0.05 to 0.10 mm.

additions.text_verbatim: wherein the substrate comprises a ceramic layer having a thickness of 0.05 to 0.10 mm

dependents.text_verbatim: The stacked thermal module of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the folded flow path has a total flow path length of at least 12 mm.

additions.text_verbatim: wherein the folded flow path has a total flow path length of at least 12 mm

dependents.text_verbatim: The stacked thermal module of claim 1, wherein the inlet port is offset from an outlet port of the fluid channel.

additions.text_verbatim: wherein the inlet port is offset from an outlet port of the fluid channel

dependents.text_verbatim: The method of claim 7, wherein the bonding is performed at a bonding temperature selected from 320, 340, 360 °C.

additions.text_verbatim: wherein the bonding is performed at a bonding temperature selected from 320, 340, 360 °C

dependents.text_verbatim: The stacked thermal module of any one of claims 4 to 6, wherein the heat spreader comprises a copper alloy.

additions.text_verbatim: wherein the heat spreader comprises a copper alloy

applicant_interest.signal: The interest is staked on forming the coolant path inside the spreader body itself; every dimension of the channel sits in a dependent claim, not in claim 1.
The method claim stakes the same structure from the assembly side: bonding first, then sealing the folded path, with no separate lid step.

items.statement_en: Putting the channel in the spreader body reads as a subtraction move: one thermal interface leaves the stack instead of one more part joining it.
evidence_quotes: the channel is formed within the spreader so that a separate cold plate is not required

items.statement_en: Read from the assembly side, the method covers the same subtraction: the folded path is closed by a sealing step, so no separate lid enters the stack.
evidence_quotes: The sealing step closes the folded flow path 214 after the spreader has been bonded, and no separate lid is used.

items.background_problem: Conventional assemblies put a cold plate on top of the module, which adds one more thermal interface.
items.asserted_effect: The specification states in words that the thermal interface count is reduced by one.
items.delta: The asserted delta is structural simplification - a part is removed - rather than a claimed performance number.
quotes: Conventional assemblies stack a cold plate on top of the module, which adds one more thermal interface.
the thermal interface count is reduced by one

items.what_it_shows_en: The section view shows the folded path doubling back inside the spreader, with the inlet and the outlet at opposite corners.
